selection.selection_rationale: The last 72 hours included the already-implemented GB margin case. Within seven days, Spain electrification provides a clear industrial decision: schedule fixed-work jobs without moving overload into cheaper hours. It fits native and QUBO optimization, adds deadlines and shared-scenario constraints, and needs no speculative hardware claim.

assumptions.data: All jobs, prices, baseline loads, limits and timestamps are engineered assumptions; no measured Spanish site or market-price series
assumptions.price: Incremental energy charge only; no taxes, demand charge, production value or renewable-content claim
assumptions.time: Six one-hour UTC intervals; release inclusive, completion deadline exclusive; complete work stays inside horizon
assumptions.uncertainty: Same advance schedule across two declared deterministic load scenarios; no calibrated probabilities
assumptions.physics: Fixed AC profiles, no interruption, migration, ramp, process precedence or thermal dynamics

repository_awareness.reuse_decision: REE connector supplies regional daily/monthly/yearly generation, not hourly site tariffs or job deadlines. Existing REE BESS screen is a separate forced-cycle economic calculation; thermal counterfactual methods analyze published HVAC forecasts. None supplies this job scheduler's required site inputs. No new network connector or artificial observed data is introduced.
